## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (3)
- `GET /bapi/mp/v4/tenant/apps/public/{publicToken}` — Get app information using a public token.

- `GET /api/i18n/-/web/cms/en/{enId}` — Get internationalization (i18n) content by ID.

- `GET /bapi/accounts/v2/public/account/ip/{ipId}` — Get account information by IP ID.
- `GET /bapi/apex/v1/friendly/apex/marketing/complianceActionCheck` — Check marketing compliance actions.
- `GET /bapi/apex/v1/public/apex/marketing/web/{webId}` — Get marketing web data (requires webId).

- `GET /bapi/c2c/v1/private/c2c/adv-order/getAdvCountInfo` — Get advertisement count information.
- `GET /bapi/c2c/v1/private/c2c/merchant/business-hours/get` — Get merchant business hours.
- `GET /bapi/c2c/v1/private/c2c/merchant/get-exchange-rate-list` — Get a list of exchange rates.
- `GET /bapi/c2c/v1/private/c2c/merchant/notification/count` — Get the count of merchant notifications.
- `GET /bapi/compliance/v1/friendly/compliance/market/banner-compliance-check` — Check market banner compliance.
- `GET /bapi/haodesk/v3/friendly/haodesk/std/base-info` — Get basic information from Haodesk.
- `GET /en/common-widget/resource/{resourceId}` — Get a specific resource by its ID.
- `GET /en/convert-modal-ui/version` — Get the version of the convert modal UI.
- `POST /bapi/c2c/v1/friendly/binance-chat/chat-group/group-list` — Get a list of chat groups.

### Data Write (2)
- `POST /bapi/c2c/v1/private/c2c/merchant/info` — Update merchant information.

### Search (5)

### Media (2)

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to C2c Admin Binance's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access C2c Admin Binance data without official API access
- Automate actions on c2c-admin.binance.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the C2c Admin Binance frontend uses
